proof_scope: Failure-history persistence/access and simplified status/task front door

claims.proves: Automatic failure history survives snapshot replacement and reload; session-filtered CLI/tool access works; corrupted lines are reported; log-write failures are visible; ON/OFF status and task alias share existing controls. A live Pi proof-repair run writes a rejection event whose candidate hash and event id are independently read back through the journal and CLI.
claims.does_not_prove: Backfilled historical sessions, every possible tool failure, live Discord delivery, hostile-user tamper resistance, or new completion authority. Synthetic event probes are distinct from the live-model run; its first proof reference is deliberately fault-injected.
